obligations.summary: The provider must keep specified documentation (technical documentation, quality management system documentation, notified body approvals and decisions, and EU declaration of conformity) available to national competent authorities for 10 years after the high-risk AI system is placed on the market or put into service.

Each Member State must establish conditions ensuring that the documentation referred to in Article 18(1) remains available to national competent authorities for the required period in cases where a provider or its authorised representative established on its territory goes bankrupt or ceases activity before the end of that period.

Providers that are financial institutions subject to Union financial services law must maintain the required technical documentation as part of the documentation kept under the applicable Union financial services law, rather than as a separate obligation.
exceptions: Financial institution providers may maintain technical documentation within existing Union financial services law documentation frameworks instead of separately.
